properties.query:
let lookback = 1h;
let Events = union CommonSecurityLog, SecurityEvent, DeviceEvents
| where TimeGenerated > ago(lookback)
| extend DeviceRef = coalesce(DeviceName, Computer)
| extend Severity = tostring(column_ifexists("AlertSeverity", column_ifexists("LogSeverity", "Medium")));
let Assets = Watchlist
| where WatchlistAlias == "AssetInventory" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by tostring(WatchlistItem["DeviceId"])
| extend DeviceId = tostring(WatchlistItem["DeviceId"]), Hostname = tostring(WatchlistItem["Hostname"]), CriticalityTier = tostring(WatchlistItem["CriticalityTier"]), SiteCode = tostring(WatchlistItem["SiteCode"]), OwningSector = tostring(WatchlistItem["OwningSector"])
| extend MatchKey = pack_array(Hostname, DeviceId)
| mv-expand MatchKey to typeof(string);
let Maintenance = Watchlist
| where WatchlistAlias == "MaintenanceWindows" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by tostring(WatchlistItem["WindowId"])
| extend SiteCode = tostring(WatchlistItem["SiteCode"]), OwningSector = tostring(WatchlistItem["OwningSector"]), MaintStart = todatetime(WatchlistItem["StartTime"]), MaintEnd = todatetime(WatchlistItem["EndTime"]);
let Changes = Watchlist
| where WatchlistAlias == "ContextCatalogue" and _DTItemType == "watchlist-item"
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) by tostring(WatchlistItem["ContextId"])
| extend DeviceId = tostring(WatchlistItem["DeviceId"]), ChangeTs = todatetime(WatchlistItem["ChangeTimestamp"]);
Events
| join kind=leftouter (Assets) on $left.DeviceRef == $right.MatchKey
| summarize arg_max(1, *) by TimeGenerated, DeviceRef
| extend IsKnownAsset = isnotempty(DeviceId)
| extend CriticalityTier = iif(IsKnownAsset, toint(CriticalityTier), -1)
| join kind=leftouter (Maintenance) on SiteCode, OwningSector
| extend InMaintenance = IsKnownAsset and isnotempty(MaintStart) and TimeGenerated between (MaintStart .. MaintEnd)
| join kind=leftouter (Changes) on DeviceId
| extend RecentChange = IsKnownAsset and isnotempty(ChangeTs) and ChangeTs between (TimeGenerated - 48h .. TimeGenerated)
| extend ContextStatus = case(not(IsKnownAsset), "UnknownAsset", InMaintenance, "InMaintenance", RecentChange, "RecentlyChanged", "NormalOps")
| extend ScoreCriticality = case(not(IsKnownAsset), 0, CriticalityTier == 0, 40, CriticalityTier == 1, 20, 5)
| extend ScoreMaintenance = iif(InMaintenance, -25, 0)
| extend ScoreChange = case(RecentChange, -10, IsKnownAsset, 5, 0)
| extend ScoreUnknown = iif(not(IsKnownAsset), 30, 0)
| extend ScoreSeverity = case(Severity == "Critical", 50, Severity == "High", 30, Severity == "Medium", 15, 0)
| extend ContextualAlertScore = ScoreCriticality + ScoreMaintenance + ScoreChange + ScoreUnknown + ScoreSeverity
| extend Disposition = case(ContextualAlertScore >= 70, "Escalate", ContextualAlertScore >= 40, "Investigate", ContextualAlertScore >= 15, "Monitor", "Suppress")
| project TimeGenerated, DeviceRef, DeviceId, Severity, ContextStatus, ContextualAlertScore, Disposition
